title: Midnight rollout lightbox checklist and staffing roster - Jul 2026 (draft)
body:
Summary:
This doc is the working checklist and staffing roster for the midnight rollout of the new "Lightbox" client-side renderer (feature flag: fb_lightbox). Target window: 2026-07-15 00:30-02:30 UTC (low traffic). Primary goal: staged enablement for 10% -> 50% -> 100% with telemetry gates. Secondary goal: minimize user-facing regressions and ensure fast rollback path.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to hosted API and Redwood Console UI surfaces that render the lightbox preview.
- Backends unchanged; change is client + serving runtime rollout that depends on inference routing variant v2-lightbox.
- Rollout uses canary routing + regional gating.
- Expected perf delta: median p95 latency +8-12ms on embed retrieval; unit tests OK but need real-world verification.

Timeline (UTC):
- 00:00 - Release captain on watch, all hands notified, standby channel #release-ops-lightbox.
- 00:10 - Preflight health checks (see checklist).
- 00:30 - Enable flag for cohort A (10%) in us-west region.
- 01:00 - Evaluate telemetry for 30m, decision point.
- 01:10 - If healthy, expand to 50% globally.
- 01:40 - Evaluate for 20m; if healthy expand to 100%.
- 02:30 - Close rollout, start 60m monitoring window.

Preflight checklist (must be green before 00:30):
- [ ] All unit/integration tests merged and green (GH-PR-1298).
- [ ] Canary infra pool has min-capacity reserved (Dedicated autoscale policy validated).
- [ ] Telemetry dashboards live: latency by route, error-rate, resource saturation, embedding error rate.
- [ ] Smoke-runbook loaded on SRE laptop (offline copy).
- [ ] RBAC & KMS keys validated for private deployments (customer-specific checks skipped).
- [ ] Night shift rotation confirmed: release captain + 2 engineers + SRE + PS on-call.
- [ ] Communication templates ready (status page, customer notif).

Lightbox-specific rollout steps:
- Step 1: Flip feature flag for cohort A via console rollout API. Record rollout ID.
- Step 2: Verify a sample of 100 requests for correct markup and no JS errors (console logs).
- Step 3: Monitor prefix/KV cache hit rate - new renderer uses cached previews; ensure cache miss rate < 5%.
- Step 4: Validate that fallback renderer is intact and functional for 502/503 scenarios.
- Step 5: Run synthetic user journey (gallery open -> expand -> close) on staging -> prod.

Telemetry & decision gates (signals to watch):
- Primary: 5xx error rate increase > 0.25% absolute -> HOLD/rollback.
- Primary: p95 latency increase > 25% over baseline -> HOLD and investigate.
- Secondary: CPU/GPU utilization spike >15% -> investigate model routing (v2-lightbox fallback).
- User facing: JS exception rate > 0.1% of lightbox opens -> rollback.
- Business: Key conversion funnel drop > 3% across cohort -> investigate.

Quick rollback matrix:
- If 5xx spike or JS exceptions exceed thresholds within any decision window -> immediate flag rollback to previous cohort config (commands below).
- Rollback steps (quick):
  1) Call rollout API to revert fb_lightbox to previous rollout ID.
  2) Pause autoscale adjustments, bring dedicated pool to baseline.
  3) Run targeted smoke tests.
  4) Notify stakeholders and open incident ticket (prefix: LIGHTBOX-RB).

Staffing roster (watch period 00:00-03:30):
- Release captain: Ethan Brooks (primary) - contact: ethan@redwood.ai, pager X1372.
- Backend lead: Maya Chen - responsible for routing/infra adjustments.
- FE lead: Sofia Alvarez - monitors JS errors and client signal.
- SRE on-call: Devon Kim - handles autoscale, pools, reserve capacity.
- PS liaison: Aaron Wallace (customer comms).
- Backup eng: TBA (fill before 2026-07-12).
- Notes: Everyone should have Slack on DND off for #release-ops-lightbox.

Communications plan:
- Pre-rollout: one hour before - post runbook summary in #release-ops and #product.
- At each expansion decision (00:30, 01:10, 01:40) - post quick status: green/yellow/red with a short note.
- If rollback: send incident stub + status page update within 15 minutes.

Post-release checklist and draft release notes (to publish if rollout completes):
- [ ] Consolidate telemetry summary and attach runbook.
- [ ] Run A/B UX check with product (samples).
- Draft release notes bullet points:
  - Feature: Lightbox preview renderer rolled out across clients (flag: fb_lightbox).
  - Impact: Optimized preview rendering for image and embedding flows, expected to reduce client-side jitter.
  - Known issues: Minor latency bump on some edge routes; fallback available.
  - Rollback: Immediate fallback available via rollout API.

Open issues / action items (owners):
- Fix: telemetry alert threshold tuning - assigned to Maya.
- Action: add synthetic scenario to nightly e2e suite for gallery flows - assigned to Sofia.
- TODO: confirm backup engineer name and pager rotation - Ethan.

Notes to self (working):
- Keep the first cohort small; prefer conservative decisions at night.
- Watch for correlated customer traffic from EMEA night windows.
- If autoscale oscillation observed, hold expansion and consult SRE.

Appendix - quick commands and links:
- Rollout API: POST /api/rollouts/{flag}/apply -> body: {"cohort": "10%", "regions": ["us-west"]} (see GH-PR-1298).
- Revert command: POST /api/rollouts/{flag}/revert?to=prev-id
- Debug logs: s3://redwood-logs/lightbox-prod/ (read-only link via Confluence).

End of draft.

(Internal: do not publish until final verification and headcount complete.)
